scope: ByteVerseToon productions; current brief overrides defaults

defaults.style: 2D character cartoon; phone/interface motion when requested or appropriate to the brief
defaults.captionDelivery: Separate SRT by default; readable burned-in phrases when requested
defaults.publishing: Only on explicit authorization for the current video/version; verify actual success
defaults.duration: Follow requested target; otherwise use concise measured narration timing
defaults.referenceStyleCaptions: Burned-in short highlighted phrases plus SRT for the requested reference-style phone/interface mode
defaults.preferredTechnologyShortRoute: Approved battery revision 03 navy illustrated causal animation for technology Shorts; keep real 3D, cartoon and other modes when the brief selects them
defaults.techExplainerStyle: Approved battery revision 03 navy illustrated causal animation, independently composed for requested regular video, Reel or Short; current brief can override

reviewRule: Record evidence separately for every category. No automatic creative or listening approval from technical checks.
listeningRule: Listen through the complete final export when supported. Otherwise explicitly keep listening review pending for the user.
characterInteractionRule: Required for character scenes; mark not applicable for a phone/interface scene and review the animated mechanism instead.
cleanupRule: Always prepare a read-only file plan, show scope/counts/estimated savings and preserved items, ask the user, and wait for explicit approval of the current plan before any deletion. Publication or a general cleanup request does not bypass confirmation; expanded scope requires another approval.

referenceStyle.inspectionLimit: Opening and multiple later scenes visually inspected; full reference audio not reviewed

motionFrameworks.customScenes: Remotion when suited to frame-driven interaction
motionFrameworks.hybrid: Supported: silent Remotion scene assets on a HyperFrames master; one audio/caption owner

glassmorphismReview: Keep text and diagrams sharp; preserve contrast as background moves
Check final exported frost, edges and shadows at 360 px width
Record native blur, layered simulation or glass-inspired fallback
real3DMotionReview: Actual frame-driven camera and mechanism motion
Preserve physical glass appearance and sharp text
Inspect decoded scene starts, seams, phone-size frames and final held ending
Keep full listening pending unless performed
